title: The ashvamedha begins; Vasishtha's arrangements
introduction: King Dasharatha requests Sage Vashishta, the Royal Priest to commence works for the Vedic ritual. Sage Vashishta instructs all the concerned about the discipline to be observed in executing the works. Sage Vashishta also instructs the minister Sumantra to invite various kings of other countries, and those kings will be received with great hospitality. King Dasharatha along with his wives takes ritual vow and enters ritual hall.
closing: इति श्री वाल्मिकिरामायणे बालकाण्डे त्रयोदशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 13th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
पुनः प्राप्ते वसन्ते तु पूर्णः संवत्सरोऽभवत् |
प्रसवार्थं गतो यष्टुं हयमेधेन वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
punaḥ prāpte vasante tu pūrṇaḥ saṃvatsaro'bhavat |
prasavārtham gato yaṣṭum hayamedhena vīryavān
verses.translation: On completion of one full year another springtime arrived, and then Dasharatha a determined one to beget progeny by performing Horse Ritual entered the ritual hall.
notes: The performer of such Vedic rituals has to perform preliminary rituals for a period of one year in order to attain eligibility to perform the final one. Here Dasharatha is said to have completed such preludes as he entering into the Vedic ritual hall in the springtime of the succeeding year to the one referred in last chapter.

verses.devanagari:
अभिवाद्य वसिष्ठं च न्यायतः प्रतिपूज्य च |
अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं प्रसवार्थं द्विजोत्तमम्
verses.iast:
abhivādya vasiṣṭham ca nyāyataḥ pratipūjya ca |
abravīt praśritam vākyam prasavārtham dvijottamam
verses.translation: Greeting and even adoring the Sage Vashishta customarily Dasharatha said these very humble words to him.

glosses.meaning: to that Brahman, the best, to Vashishta, on greeting

verses.devanagari:
यज्ञो मे क्रियतां ब्रह्मन् यथोक्तं मुनिपुङ्गव |
यथा न विघ्नः क्रियते यज्ञांगेषु विधीयताम्
verses.iast:
yajño me kriyatām brahman yathoktam munipuñgava |
yathā na vighnāḥ kriyante yajñāṅgeṣu vidhīyatām
verses.translation: "Let my ritual be performed scripturally, oh eminent Brahman, let it be conducted in such a way that no obstacle occurs even in its ancillary functions.

glosses.meaning: ritual, of, mine, as said [in scriptures] be performed
as to how, no, obstacles, be occurred

verses.devanagari:
भवान्स्निग्धः सुहृन्मह्यं गुरुश्च परमो महान् |
वोढव्यो भवता चैव भारो यज्ञस्य चोद्यतः
verses.iast:
bhavān snigdhaḥ suhṛn mahyam guruḥ ca paramo mahān |
voḍhavyo bhavatā ca eva bhāro yajñasya ca udyataḥ
verses.translation: "You being my very reverent royal priest are friendly and kind-hearted to me, and you alone shall shoulder the burden of the commenced ritual in all good faith and credence.

glosses.meaning: you are, friendly, kind-hearted, to me
by you, alone, that shoulder it.

verses.devanagari:
तथेति च स राजानमब्रवीत् द्विजसत्तमः |
करिष्ये सर्वमेवैतद्भवता यत्समर्थितम्
verses.iast:
tathā iti ca sa rājānam abravīt dvijasattamaḥ |
kariṣye sarvam eva etat bhavatā yat samarthitam
verses.translation: Then that reverent Brahman Vashishta said to king, "Whatever that is requested or decided by you, I will see that all of them are materialised accordingly.

glosses.meaning: by you, that which, is requested, or decided
all, accordingly, I will make happen

verses.devanagari:
ततोऽब्रवीत् द्विजान्वृद्धान् यज्ञकर्मसु निष्ठितान् |
स्थापत्ये निष्ठितांश्चैव वृद्धान्परमधार्मिकान्
कर्मान्तिकान् शिल्पकरान् वर्धकीन् खनकानपि |
गणकान् शिल्पिनश्चैव तथैव नटनर्तकान्
तथा शुचीन् शास्त्रविदः पुरुषान्सुबहुश्रुतान् |
यज्ञकर्म समीहन्तां भवन्तो राजशासनात्
इष्टका बहुसाहस्री शीघ्रमानीयतामिति |
औपकार्याः क्रियन्तां च राज्ञो बहुगुणान्विताः
verses.iast:
tato'bravīt dvijān vṛddhān yajña karmasu niṣṭhitān |
sthāpatye niṣṭhitām ca eva vṛddhān parama dhārmikān
karma antikān śilpakārān vardhakīn khanakān api |
gaṇakān śilpinaḥ ca eva tathā eva naṭa nartakān
tathā śucīn śāstra vidaḥ puruṣān su bahu śrutān |
yajña karma samīhantām bhavanto rāja śāsanāt
iṣṭakā bahu sāhasrī śīghram ānīyatām iti |
upakāryāḥ kriyantām ca rājño bahu guṇānvitāḥ
verses.translation: Then Sage Vashishta then summoned and spoke to elderly Brahman scholars, and elderly architects who are all proficient and elderly experts in conducting the construction of the ritual hall etc. Then summoned are the construction supervisors, brick-makers, carpenters, earth-diggers, accountants, and sculptors. So also the actors and dancers are summoned. Thus flawless scholars in scriptures and those men who are well read in Veda-s, are called and he addressed them saying, "Performance of the ritual be organised by the order of the king. Bricks in many thousands be brought quickly and royal palaces as temporary guesthouses be built for the kingly guests, with very many facilities included in them.
notes: A detailed description of the components of Vedic ritual hall is given at the endnote of next chapter, wherein King Dasharatha enters. Vedic ritual cannot be performed in ordinary households or in small temples. A very large place is selected, as per architectural science, and at its centre a homa kunda, an altar of fire will be constructed. This area will not have any roofing so as to let the vapours of oblations of ghee, sandalwood paste and others offered into the fire of altar, get into the atmosphere and thereby to Heavens. Around this altar of fire, huge sheds will be constructed to accommodate thousands of participants and onlookers. Apart from this, mammoth kitchens and dining halls are to be constructed as all of the thousands of participants, who are to be fed as long as ritual is conducted. Some of the many tradesmen are listed in a bird's eye view as above.

glosses.meaning: then [Sage Vashishta,] spoken to, to Brahmans, elderly scholars
thus, flawless, scriptures, scholars, to those men
royal palaces [guest houses,] be built, also.

verses.devanagari:
ब्राह्मणावसथाश्चैव कर्तव्याः शतशः शुभाः |
भक्ष्यान्नपानैर्बहुभिः समुपेताः सुनिष्ठिताः
verses.iast:
brāhmaṇa āvasathāḥ caiva kartavyāḥ śataśaḥ śubhāḥ |
bhakṣya anna pānaiḥ bahubhiḥ samupetāḥ suniṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: "Like that, for accommodating Brahmans hundreds of sanctified houses be built, well endowed and well established with very many eatables, foods, and potables.

glosses.meaning: in hundreds, are to be done [built.]

verses.devanagari:
तथा पौरजनस्यापि कर्तव्याश्च सुविस्तराः |
आगतानां सुदूराच्च पार्थिवानां पृथक् पृथक्
verses.iast:
tathā paura janasya api kartavyāḥ ca suvistarāḥ |
āgatānām sudūrāt ca pārthivānām pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: "So also, accommodation is to be given for city dwellers too, in very spacious housing, and severally for the kings arriving from distant places.

glosses.meaning: very, spacious [accomodation,] is to be done [built,] even
to those arriving, from distant places, also
to kings, separately, separately [accommodation is to be given.]

verses.devanagari:
वाजिवारणशलाश्च तथा शय्यागृहाणि च |
भटानां महदावास वैदेशिकनिवासिनाम्
verses.iast:
vājivāraṇa śalāḥ ca tathā śayyā gṛhāṇi ca |
bhaṭānām mahadāvāsam vaideśika nivāsinām
verses.translation: "For horses stables, reposing stalls for elephants, like that great billets for soldiers may be built for those foreign-country dwellers arriving in here on their horses and elephants along with their soldiers.

verses.devanagari:
आवासा बहुभक्ष्या वै सर्वकामैरुपस्थिताः |
तथा पौरजनस्यापि जनस्य बहुशोभनम्
verses.iast:
āvāsā bahu bhakṣyā vai sarva kāmaiḥ upasthitāḥ |
tathā paurajansya api janasya bahu śobhanam
verses.translation: "These lodgings are to be arranged with many foods and utilities for the people of this city and for others coming from distant countries, and a very grand food be given in all of them.

glosses.meaning: thus, for this city dwellers also
for [other] people, very, grand [food be given.]

verses.devanagari:
दातव्यमन्नं विधिवत्सत्कृत्य न तु लीलया |
सर्वे वर्णा यथा पूजां प्राप्नुवन्ति सुसत्कृताः
न चावज्ञा प्रयोक्तव्या कामक्रोधवशादपि |
verses.iast:
dātavyam annam vidhivat satkṛtya na tu līlayā |
sarve varṇā yathā pūjām prāpnuvanti susatkṛtāḥ
na ca avajñā prayoktavyā kāma krodha vaśāt api |
verses.translation: "Food is to be given dutifully treating all of them well but not just illusively, and the people of all the castes shall be well honoured as they would get their due respect, and no disrespect be shown, even when overcome by passion or anger at anyone.

glosses.meaning: as they would, respects, they get
well honoured na cha avaj~naa prayoktavya = not any, disrespect, be shown [to anyone]

verses.devanagari:
यज्ञकर्मसु ये व्यग्राः पुरुषाः शिल्पिनस्तथा
तेषामपि विशेषेण पूजा कार्या यथाक्रमम् |
ये स्युः संपूजिता सर्वे वसुभिर्भोजनेन च
verses.iast:
yajña karmasu ye vyagrāḥ puruṣāḥ śilpinaḥ tathā
teṣām api viśeṣeṇa pūjā kāryā yathā kramam |
ye syuḥ sampūjitā sarve vasubhiḥ bhojanena ca
verses.translation: "Exceptionally respectable are those men and architects that are preoccupied in the works of the ritual as they deserve, and those men involved in these works shall be well-treated with funds and food.

glosses.meaning: respectability, to be done, as they, deserve
those, all, with funds, with foods, also

verses.devanagari:
यथा सर्वं सुविहितं न किंचित्परिहीयते |
तथा भवन्तः कुर्वन्तु प्रीतियुक्तेन चेतसा
verses.iast:
yathā sarvam suvihitam na kiñcit parihīyate |
tathā bhavantaḥ kurvantu prīti yuktena cetasā
verses.translation: "Thus, as to how all this be well organised without least negligence, thus you all shall administer in all your cooperation and good spirit." Thus Sage Vashishta spoke to the organisers.

glosses.meaning: all this, as to how, will be well, organised
in the least, not, be neglected

verses.devanagari:
ततः सर्वे समागम्य वसिष्ठमिदमब्रुवन् |
यथेष्टं तत्सुविहितं न किंचित्परिहीयते
यथोक्तं तत्करिष्यामो न किंचित्परिहास्यते |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sarve samāgaṃya vasiṣṭham idam abruvan |
yatheṣṭam tat suvihitam na kiñcit parihīyate
yathoktam tat kariṣyāmo na kiñcit parihīyate |
verses.translation: Then all of them collectively replied to Sage Vashishta "As desired, all the well ordered works will not be neglected in the least, and they will be done as ordered, and not the least of them will be slighted." So said the artisans to Sage Vashishta.

glosses.meaning: as desired, that, well ordered [will be done]
not, in the least, will be neglected
as, said, that, we will do

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुमंत्रमाहूय वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
निमंत्रयस्व नृपतीन्पृथिव्यां ये च धार्मिकाः |
ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् वैश्यान् शूद्रांश्चैव सहस्रशः
समानयस्व सत्कृत्य सर्वदेशेषु मानवान् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sumantram āhūya vasiṣṭho vākyam abravīt
nimantrayasva nṛpatīn pṛthivyām ye ca dhārmikāḥ |
brāhmaṇān kṣatriyān vaiśyān śūdrām ca eva sahasraśaḥ
samānayasva satkṛtya sarva deśeṣu mānavān |
verses.translation: "Then on calling for Sumantra, Sage Vashishta said these words to him, "Let all those kings of the earth that are righteous be invited, and let all the people from all the kingdoms, say Brahmans, Kshatriya-s, Vyasya-s, Shudra-s be invited in scores duly honouring them." So said Vashishta to Sumantra.

glosses.meaning: on the earth, those, that are righteous ones, [those] kings, be invited
also, thus, in thousands [scores of tem]
on honouring, let them be invited.

verses.devanagari:
मिथिलाधिपतिं शूरं जनकं सत्यवादिनम्
तमानय महाभागं स्वयमेव सुसत्कृतम् |
पूर्वसंबन्धिनं ज्ञात्वा ततः पूर्वं ब्रवीमि ते
verses.iast:
mithilādhipatim śūram janakam satya vādinam
tam ānaya mahābhāgam svayam eva susatkṛtam |
pūrva sambandhinam jñātvā tataḥ pūrvam bravīmi te
verses.translation: "You personally invite Janaka the king of Mithila, a valiant one and an advocate of truth, honouring his well and duly bearing in mind that he is a long-time associate of our King Dasharatha, hence I am telling you in the first instance.

glosses.meaning: Mithila kingdom's, king, valiant one, King Janaka

verses.devanagari:
तथा काशीपतिं स्निग्धं सततं प्रियवादिनम् |
सद् वृत्तं देवसंकाशं स्वयमेवानयस्व ह
verses.iast:
tathā kāśī patim snigdham satatam priya vādinam |
sad vṛttam devasaṅkāśam svayam eva anayasva ha
verses.translation: "Thus that King of Kaashi who is always a friendly, affectionate and a cordial one, indeed he shall be invited by you personally.

glosses.itrans: snigdham satatam priya vaadinam sat vR^ittam
glosses.iast: snigdham satatam priya vādinam sat vṛttam
glosses.devanagari: स्निग्धं सततं प्रिय वादिनं सत् वृत्तं
glosses.meaning: one who is friendly, always, affection, desiring one, well behaved [cordial] one

verses.devanagari:
तथा केकयराजानं वृद्धं परमधार्मिकम् |
श्वशुरं राजसिंहस्य सपुत्रं त्वमिहानय
verses.iast:
tathā kekaya rājānam vṛddham parama dhārmikam |
śvaśuram rāja siṃhasya saputram tvam iha ānaya
verses.translation: "Likewise, King of Kekaya, an elderly, very virtuous, and also the father-in-law of our Lion-King Dasharatha, you personally invite him along with his sons.

glosses.meaning: along with his sons, you, here, invite.

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गेश्वरं महेष्वासं रोमपादं सुसत्कृतम् |
वयस्यं राजसिंहस्य समानय यशस्विनम्
verses.iast:
añgeśvaram maheṣvāsam romapādam su satkṛtam |
vayasyam rāja siṃhasya saputram tam iha ānaya
verses.translation: "Romapada, the lord of Anga kingdom and the user of great bow, let that illustrious one be invited well honoured, for he is the friend of our lion-king Dasharatha.

glosses.meaning: Romapada, well, honoured, sam aanaya = well, be invited.

verses.devanagari:
तथा कोसलराजानं भानुमंतं सुसत्कृतम् |
मगधाधिपतिं शूरं सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम्
verses.iast:
tathā kosala rājānam bhānumantam susatkṛtam |
magadha adhipatim śūram sarva śāstra viśāradam
verses.translation: "Like that King of Kosala namely Bhanumanta, and the King of Magadha, a brave one and a profound one in all scriptural knowledge, let them be honoured well and be invited.

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्तिज्ञं परमोदारं सत्कृतं पुरुषर्षभम् |
राज्ञः शासनमादाय चोदयस्व नृपर्षभान् |
प्राचीनान् सिन्धुसौवीरान् सौराष्ट्रेयांश्च पार्थिवान्
verses.iast:
prāptijñam paramodāram susatkṛtam puruṣarṣabham |
rājñaḥ śāsanam ādāya codayasva nṛparṣabhān |
prācīnān sindhu sauvīrān saurāṣṭhreyām ca pārthivān
verses.translation: "And Praaptijna, the king of Magadha, the kind-hearted and best one among kings, be well honoured and invited. Further, taking the orders of King Dasharatha and motivated by those orders, the kings of Sindhu, Sauviira and Sauraastra kingdoms may also be invited.

glosses.meaning: Sindhu, Sauviira, Sauraastra, also, kings of.

verses.devanagari:
दाक्षिणात्यान्नरेन्द्रांश्च समस्तानानयस्व ह |
सन्ति स्निग्धाश्च ये चान्ये राजानः पृथिवीतले
तानानय यथा क्षिप्रं सानुगान् सहबान्धवान् |
एतान् दूतैर्महाभागैरानयस्व नृपाज्ञया
verses.iast:
dākṣiṇātyān narendrām ca samastān ānayasva ha |
santi snigdhāḥ ca ye ca anye rājānaḥ pṛthivī tale
tān ānaya yathā kṣipram sa anugān saha bāndhavān |
etān dūtaiḥ mahābhāgaiḥ ānayasva nṛpa ājñyā
verses.translation: "All of the kings of southern kingdoms be invited, and should there be any other friends and other friendly kings on the surface of the earth, they too shall be invited as early as possible with all their followers, relatives through highly illustrious envoys, of course with the orders of our king." Thus Sage Vashishta said to minister Sumantra.

glosses.meaning: all of them, be invited, verily

glosses.itrans: santi snigdhaaH cha ye cha anye
glosses.iast: santi snigdhāḥ ca ye ca anye
glosses.devanagari: सन्ति स्निग्धाः च ये च अन्ये
glosses.meaning: should there be, friends, other, those, also, other
them, be invited, as early as
along with, followers, along with, their relatives
them, highly illustrious ones, through envoys

verses.devanagari:
वसिष्ठवाक्यं तच्छ्रुत्वा सुमंत्रस्त्वरितस्तदा |
व्यादिशत्पुरुषांस्तत्र राज्ञामानयने शुभान्
verses.iast:
vasiṣṭha vākyam tat śrutvā sumantraḥ tvaritaḥ tadā |
vyādiśat puruṣān tatra rājñām ānayane śubhān
verses.translation: On hearing that word of Vashishta, Sumantra expeditiously ordered devout envoys to invite all those kings to their kingdom.

glosses.meaning: that, Sage Vashishta's, words, on hearing
kings, there [to their kingdom,] for inviting

verses.devanagari:
स्वयमेव हि धर्मात्मा प्रयातो मुनिशासनात् |
सुमंत्रस्त्वरितो भूत्वा समानेतुं महीक्षितः
verses.iast:
svayam eva hi dharmātmā prayāto muni śāsanāt |
sumantraḥ tvarito bhūtvā samānetum mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: That virtuous Sumantra became brisk upon sage's words and personally journeyed to fetch all the rulers on the earth.

verses.devanagari:
ते च कर्मान्तिकाः सर्वे वसिष्ठाय महर्षये |
सर्वं निवेदयन्ति स्म यज्ञे यदुपकल्पितम्
verses.iast:
te ca karmāntikāḥ sarve vasiṣṭhāya ca maharṣaye |
sarvam nivedayanti sma yajñe yat upakalpitam
verses.translation: All those artisans engaged in ritual works have reported Vashishta, the details of all those ritual works that are accomplished.

glosses.meaning: in ritual, works, that are accomplished

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रीतो द्विजश्रेष्ठस्तान्सर्वान्मुनिरब्रवीत् |
अवज्ञया न दातव्यं कस्यचिल्लीलयापि वा
अवज्ञया कृतं हन्याद्दातारं नात्र संशयः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ prīto dvija śreṣṭhaḥ tān sarvān munir abravīt |
avajñayā na dātavyam kasya cit līlayā api vā
avajñayā kṛtam hanyāt dātāram na atra saṃśayaḥ |
verses.translation: Then, that satisfied saint and eminent Brahman Vashishta, spoke this way to all of them, "nothing is to be endowed to anyone either with disrespect or deceptively, the deeds done with disrespect will kill the donor and there is no doubt about it."

glosses.meaning: then, satisfied, Brahman, eminent, saint, Sage Vashishta
with disrespect, not, to be endowed
with disrespect, done [deeds,] will kill, donor

verses.devanagari:
ततः कैश्चिदहोरात्रैरुपयाता महीक्षितः
बहूनि रत्नान्यादाय राज्ञो दशरथस्य ह |
verses.iast:
tataḥ kaiścit aho rātraiḥ upayātā mahīkṣitaḥ
bahūni ratnāni ādāya rājño daśarathasya ha |
verses.translation: Then in some days and nights many kings have arrived taking precious gems with them as gifts for Dasharatha.

glosses.meaning: in some, days and nights, arrived.

verses.devanagari:
ततो वसिष्ठः सुप्रीतो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्
उपयाता नरव्याघ्र राजानस्तव शासनात् |
मयापि सत्कृताः सर्वे यथार्हं राजसत्तमाः
verses.iast:
tato vasiṣṭhaḥ suprīto rājānam idam abravīt
upayātā nara vyāghra rājānaḥ tava śāsanāt |
mayā api satkṛtāḥ sarve yathā arham rāja sattama
verses.translation: Then the well pleased Sage Vashishta said this to King Dasharatha "the kings from distant kingdoms have arrived at your behest, oh, tigerly-man, and thse best kings are well honoured by me also as per their status.

glosses.meaning: by me, also, well honoured, all
as per their status, kings, the great.

verses.devanagari:
यज्ञीयं च कृतं सर्वं पुरुषैः सुसमाहितैः |
निर्यातु च भवान्यष्टुं यज्ञायतनमन्तिकात्
verses.iast:
yajñīyam ca kṛtam sarvam puruṣaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ |
niryātu ca bhavān yaṣṭum yajña āyatanam antikāt
verses.translation: "All the ritual works are also completed by the well coalescent men, thus you may start towards the ritual place that is nearby, to perform your ritual." Said Sage Vashishta to King Dasharatha.

glosses.meaning: that is nearby, ritual hall, you may proceed.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वकामैरुपहृतैरुपेतं वै समन्ततः |
द्रष्टुमर्हसि राजेन्द्र मनसेव विनिर्मितम्
verses.iast:
sarvakāmaiḥ upahṛtaiḥ upetam vai samantataḥ |
draṣṭum arhasi rājendra manaseva vinirmitam
verses.translation: "All the desirable paraphernalia is arranged and made available everywhere, and it is apt of you see ritual hall that is as though built by your mere wish.

verses.devanagari:
तथा वसिष्ठवचनादृष्यशृङ्गस्य चोभयोः |
शुभे दिवसनक्षत्रे निर्यातो जगतीपतिः
verses.iast:
tathā vasiṣṭha vacanāt ṛṣyaśṛngasya ca ubhayoḥ |
divase śubha nakśatre niryāto jagatīpatiḥ
verses.translation: Thus, on a good day while the ruling star of the day is favourable, King Dasharatha came forth towards the ritual hall according to the advice of both the sages Vashishta and Rishyasringa.
notes: In undertaking of auspicious works, Hindus watch out for date, day, and the star of the day, called tithi, vāra, nakśatra in accordance with astrological import. In addition to these three are two more yoga and karaṇa , which when added together this becomes pancānga, five-aspects of time, which are essential to verify before conducting any auspicious work.

verses.devanagari:
ततो वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्व एव द्विजोत्तमाः |
ऋष्यशृङ्गं पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञकर्मारभंस्तदा
verses.iast:
tato vasiṣṭha pramukhāḥ sarva eva dvijottamāḥ |
ṛṣyaśṛngam puraskṛtya yajña karma ārabhan tadā
verses.translation: Then Sage Vashishta and other eminent Brahmans keeping the Sage Rishyasringa ahead of them entered the ritual hall, to commence the ritual works thus.

glosses.meaning: then, Vashishta, and other eminent ones

verses.devanagari:
यज्ञवाटं गताः सर्वे यथाशास्त्रं यथाविधि |
श्रीमांश्च सह पत्नीभी राजा दीक्षामुपाविशत्
verses.iast:
yajña vāṭam gatāḥ sarve yathā śāstram yathā vidhi |
śrīmān ca saha patnībhī rājā dīkśām upāviśat
verses.translation: When all have entered the ritual hall as per canons and custom, that glorious king Dasharatha along with his wives undertook vow of ritual.

glosses.meaning: all, to ritual hall, on going
as per canons, as per custom
